title: RESTORE
captionSeedOnly:
Import one Arkade wallet from a BIP39 recovery phrase
(12 or 24 words).
captionSeedPasskeyNote: A passkey alone is not enough to recover imported wallets after a fresh install. Export each wallet’s seed, or use Backup (Nostr / Home server) from onboarding.
captionFull:
Restore with seed imports just a single Arkade wallet.
With nsec and Server options you can restore encrypted
packages with multiple wallets.
captionFullPasskeyNote: A passkey alone does not restore non-PRF wallets after a fresh install. Prefer one of the backup methods below.
nsecHint: Multi-wallet encrypted package. Passphrase always required.
nsecMustStart: Must start with nsec1… (not npub). Export it before Reset if you have not already.
passphraseLossCaption:
Lose this passphrase = lose wallet access.
Save it offline. Basic cannot recover it.
serverHint: Download the encrypted package via WebDAV (Nextcloud) or Bearer token, then unwrap with nsec + passphrase.
confirmRestoreNostr: Confirm to restore from Nostr package
identityImportedBody: No encrypted package on this device or relays. Use Seed for one Arkade wallet, or enable backup after create.
restoredPackageBody:
%{count} wallet(s): %{labels}%{notes}%{contacts}%{prefs}

Nostr backup is on (same passphrase as restore).
serverUrlRequired: Enter the home server / Nextcloud URL.
credentialsRequiredBody: Enter username + application password, or a Bearer access token.
nsecRequiredUnwrap: nsec is required to unwrap the package.
confirmRestoreHome: Confirm to restore from home server
restoredHomeBody:
%{count} wallet(s): %{labels}%{notes}%{contacts}%{prefs}

Home server backup is on (same URL + passphrase as restore).
